scope: Custom study-domain isolation, auxiliary-role preservation and dual-component filter populations. Synthetic known answers establish implementation behavior; protected replays check reproducibility, not independent environmental accuracy.

reproduced_before_fix.previous_status: exploratory with zero common study cells

reproduced_before_fix.case: P07 with extreme other-component values outside the study

fixed_behavior: Only actual consumed auxiliary roles extend the processing footprint.
Measurement maps/statistics use the study domain; raw source/quality/reference/intermediate diagnostics retain explicit wider scopes where appropriate.
A phase reference can lie outside the study, but comparison ground must remain inside it.
Both offset components use the same study population for spatial screening; outside stable samples retain native-quality screening for median-bias checks.
Elementary workflows retain/apply shared domain geometry and retain phase reference samples until LOS conversion.
COG tags and scientific fingerprints record the spatial contract; affected historical boundary paths get a rerun notice.
